_comment: OPTIONAL - only needed for the Telnyx L2 upgrade. Business identity for Telnyx Number Reputation Enterprise vetting. Copy to enterprise.json and fill in. Used ONCE by `telnyx_setup.py register`. Field names + enums verified against Telnyx POST /v2/enterprises (see references/telnyx-api-contract.md). EIN format XX-XXXXXXX. website must be a live HTTPS URL.
_industry_note: industry is a fixed Telnyx enum; 'real_estate' is expected valid but confirm against the live API error if register 422s (alternatives seen: technology, healthcare, retail, finance, legal, insurance). number_of_employees enum: 1-10|11-50|51-200|201-500|501-2000|2001-10000|10001+.
